{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(sales.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(sales.head())

# Check for the presence of 'refunded' status
print('\nStatus value counts:')
print(sales['status'].value_counts())

# Check for any rows with status 'refunded'
refunded_rows = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'\nNumber of refunded orders: {len(refunded_rows)}')

# The number of completed orders
completed_orders = len(sales[sales['status'] == 'completed'])
print(f'\nNumber of completed orders: {completed_orders}')"}
